blind.description: A low-poly stylized wooden firewood rack filled with neatly stacked logs. The rack consists of four vertical wooden posts at the corners (two on each end) connected by bottom/side rails in a dark warm brown wood finish. Inside, split logs and round wooden billets are stacked horizontally, showing alternating tones of reddish-orange fresh cut wood and darker bark-covered logs. The geometry is solid, stylized, and continuous with no holes, floating flakes, or broken polygons. The rack sits directly and flat on the ground plane without an added base slab.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a long rectangular bar with four square corner post caps at the ends and a row of transverse rectangular/cylindrical log tops packed side-by-side in alternating light and dark brown/orange tones.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 ft tall) and slightly wider than half the figure's height in length (around 3 to 3.5 ft long), with a narrow depth of roughly 1 ft.
